title: The AI Stock Market Just Got 3 Massive Signals!!
creator: Jose Najarro Stocks
summary: Jose Najarro covers three earnings and investor-day signals for AI and semiconductor investors: Alphabet, Microsoft and Oracle. On Alphabet, Cloud crossed 30 billion dollars for the first time, up 103 percent year over year with a 36.2 percent operating margin and TPU systems contributing meaningfully, making Google the fastest-growing hyperscaler; but search growth of 12 percent is the bearish flag, with AI Overviews cannibalising search faster than expected and monetising below traditional search, plus a second straight free-cash-flow-negative quarter of about 9.1 billion dollars. On Microsoft, Azure re-accelerated to 48 percent growth with 49 to 50 percent constant-currency guidance, beating roughly 44 percent expectations despite third-party GPU delays, and Microsoft stands out as the only free-cash-flow-positive hyperscaler at about 18 billion dollars, with calendar 2027 capex possibly reaching 225 to 250 billion dollars. On Oracle, fiscal 2027 revenue is targeted at 90 billion dollars and fiscal 2030 at over 225 billion dollars with over 21 dollars of EPS, implying north of 500 dollars at a 25 times multiple — though Oracle's statement that capex peaks in fiscal 2027-2028 then steps down in 2029, without sizing either, feeds fears of slower chip orders, which he argues is not the full picture since capex dollars do not equal chip units. No explicit buy or sell is stated for any of the three names.
